title: Settle disagreements about a Plan slide by slide
statement: As a developer, I can comment on, approve, or request changes on each slide of a Plan, the way I do on a review deck, so disagreements about the approach are settled where they are shown and before code is written.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A reviewer can record approved or changes requested on any one slide of a Plan, attributed to that reviewer as human or AI, as on a review slide.
A reviewer can comment on a Plan slide or one of its Items, others can reply, and the thread can be resolved and reopened.
When a Plan slide changes after a decision was recorded on it, that decision is shown as out of date on that slide, while decisions on unchanged slides stay current.
The tool reports each reviewer's current decision on each slide and never declares a whole Plan approved.
